name: plugin_loader
description: A small package: imp.reload (removed), Optional/Dict, utcnow in one module, unittest aliases in one test file, and a constants module that needs nothing.

files.tests/test_loader.py:
from plugins.loader import load, reload


def test_load_and_reload():
    module = load("json")
    assert module.__name__ == "json"
    assert reload("json").__name__ == "json"


def test_missing_module_is_none():
    assert load("no_such_module_here") is None
    assert reload("never_loaded") is None
